items.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004
items.q: So we do this song with Dave Matthews, who became a big friend of the band’s. We toured and did a bunch of shows with him so it was a very natural thing.

ctx.x: Okay well I’m babbling. I don’t know what we were into. Oh we were into —

Oh about commerciality. So we do this song with Dave Matthews, who became a big friend of the band’s. We toured and did a bunch of shows with him so it was a very natural thing. He said, “hey if there’s anything you guys ever want me to do I’ll be there in five minutes.” So I thought wow that’s a pretty neat thing to say. And plus we liked him and we thought he was artistic too. So we got him to sing this song. And the people said, “oh they did it to commercialize.” And I always thought well if we were going to…
And you’re always going to irritate somebody I think, in the music business.
